hook_say: Here is why a $22 hourly guess underprices house cleaning by about $33 an hour.

rows.label: Take-home pay you want per year
rows.why: Start with what you want to keep for yourself: $48,000 a year after taxes.

rows.label: Hours you work per year, all of it
rows.say: 2,160 hours a year, all of it
rows.why: 48 weeks at 45 hours a week is 2,160 hours, counting texts, quotes, invoicing, laundry and supply runs.

rows.label: Share spent cleaning or driving to jobs
rows.say: Only 70% is cleaning or job driving
rows.why: Only about 70% of those hours are cleaning or driving to jobs, the hours a quote can charge for.

rows.label: Business costs per month
rows.why: Add $505 a month for insurance, supplies, equipment, phone, apps, marketing and fees.

rows.label: The guess: pay divided by all hours
rows.why: Divide pay by every hour worked and you get $22.22. That leaves out costs, taxes and unpaid hours.

rows.label: Break-even rate per cleaning hour
rows.why: Add self-employment tax, an estimated 12% income tax and your costs, spread over billable hours only: break-even is $46.98 per cleaning hour.

fix.label: Target rate with 15% profit
fix.why: Build in a 15% profit margin and the target is $55.27 per cleaning hour. The Quote Builder prices every house from this.
